categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Adds a method to interfaces::Wallet for GUI use; category guidelines specify that wallet PRs adding methods to interfaces::Wallet are not IPC unless interface mechanics are the point.
categories.rationale: Not an IPC PR under category guidelines because interface mechanics are not the subject of the change.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies wallet internals in src/wallet/wallet.cpp, RPC handling, and src/interfaces/wallet.h.
categories.rationale: Extracts HD key derivation from RPC into CWallet and exposes it over interfaces::Wallet so the GUI can derive xpubs without RPC access. This directly unblocks the deriveHDKey component of the Multisig Wizard tracking issue (#35645).
